premises.text: Hourly professionals lose large amounts of billable mobile call time because tracking is time-consuming and methods are weak
premises.evidence_span: roughly 40% of the time, professionals that build by the hour spend talking on a mobile phone goes unbilled

premises.text: A third button on the mobile call screen automatically starts tracking the call for billing when pressed
premises.evidence_span: adding a third button to the mobile call screen

value.text: Capture previously missed mobile client call time for billing professionals
value.evidence_span: our app automatically starts tracking that call for billing

causal_links.evidence_span: you forget to bill those calls
our app automatically starts tracking that call for billing

notes: Downloads/users and seed ask excluded as traction/financing. Target roles (attorneys/consultants/coaches) folded into value audience, not a separate market premise. Both domains are singletons with distinct need vs capture mechanism.
